description: [Wicked Registry] Search x402/MCP tools by real reliability data (uptime, latency, schema conformance). Works via x402 (402 carries payment instructions) or a free API key (pass api_key, or set REGISTRY_API_KEY). No key yet? Call registry_onboarding_message then registry_create_api_key to get one yourself. For a quick free check of a known tool, use registry_lookup.

api_key.description: Free Wicked Registry API key (wr_...). Overrides REGISTRY_API_KEY.

min_score.description: Minimum composite score 0-100; unchecked tools are excluded once set.

name: registry_search_tools
